<!--
Reusable workflow diagram, written with Pandoc fenced divs (markdown content).
Included on a slide with:  {{< include _workflow-diagram.qmd >}}
Styling lives in bms-reveal.scss under the "workflow diagram" section.

NOTE: titles here use bracketed spans ([text]{.class}), NOT ### headings.
Headings inside a slide become nested <section> elements, which reveal.js
treats as vertical slides and which break linear navigation.

Edit the stage titles and bullets below; add/remove .stage blocks as needed.
Colon counts decrease as you nest (outer > inner) so Pandoc pairs them:
::::::  .workflow
 :::::  .workflow-group
  ::::  .stage-row   (keeps a group's stages on one row under its title)
   :::  .stage / .arrow
-->
